videos.overview: The No. 7 Texas Longhorns (6-2) visit the No. 18 Missouri Tigers (6-2) at Memorial Stadium for an SEC game. Missouri beat Arkansas 34-10 behind two Austin Simmons touchdowns, while Texas seeks three straight wins after beating Mississippi State 31-3.

videos.overview: The No. 13 Tennessee Volunteers clash with the No. 6 Kentucky Wildcats in an SEC matchup. Tennessee has 39 quarterback hits to defend home turf after five straight rivalry wins, while Kentucky leans on a one-interception record over eight games.
